proposed_urls.rationale: Gov Code Title 3 Ch. 305 (Registration of Lobbyists) - full lobbying-disclosure statute body, directory-level leaf.

notes: TX 2010 not hosted on Justia (https://law.justia.com/codes/texas/2010/ returns 'Page not found' - 404 evidence preserved in pass1_state_index_2010_404.html). Fell back to actual_vintage_used=2009 per curated path in src/scoring/lobbying_statute_urls.py. TX 2009 tree is 4 levels deep: state -> code -> title -> chapter (no subtitle layer, unlike TX 2015 which inserted subtitle-a). Government Code title chosen at pass 1 (Election Code = campaign finance, intentionally excluded; Penal Code unrelated). Title 3 (Legislative Branch) directly lists Ch. 305 as a sibling chapter; intermediate pass-2 fetch on title-3-legislative-branch/ required. Pass-3 fetch on chapter-305-registration-of-lobbyists/ returned an empty TSV, confirming it is a directory-level leaf containing the full statute body (matches the curated TX 2009 example B in pass-2 prompt). Compared with TX 2015 known-good which routes through subtitle-a, TX 2009 has the simpler title->chapter structure - subtitle reorganization is a post-2009 change.
